condiciones-cronicas.title: Diabetes, Hypertension & Cholesterol Care
condiciones-cronicas.description: Diabetes, high blood pressure and cholesterol care in Houston: in-clinic labs, medication adjustments and a meal plan, in Spanish.
condiciones-cronicas.longDescription:
If you live with diabetes, high blood pressure or high cholesterol and triglycerides, Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner keeps your care on track over time: we draw your lab samples on site, compare your numbers at every visit, adjust medications when needed and build an eating plan with you that actually fits your kitchen at home.

## What gets checked at a follow-up visit?

- **Blood sugar**, to see how your body is responding to diabetes treatment
- **Blood pressure**, taken at rest and logged so it can be compared with last time
- **Cholesterol and triglycerides**, through a lab panel
- The medications you take today, their doses and any side effects
- Your weight, your meals and how active you are during the week

## Why isn't feeling fine enough?

High sugar and high blood pressure rarely hurt in the early years. Meanwhile they slowly wear down the heart, the kidneys, your eyesight and the nerves in your feet. That is why follow-up relies on numbers rather than on how you feel that morning: putting one result next to the previous one lets the medical team correct course before a complication shows up.

## How does treatment change over time?

Once your results are in, the medical team decides whether to keep the dose, change it or add another medication. Anything prescribed during the visit can be picked up at the [clinic pharmacy](/en/services/farmacia). We also go over which dishes from your usual cooking can stay, which ones to cut back on, and what kind of exercise suits your schedule.

## What should I bring to the visit?

- Your pill bottles or a written list of what you take
- Your glucose meter or the notebook with your home readings, if you keep one
- Recent [blood test](/en/services/examenes-sangre) results, even from another clinic

If your job keeps you busy on weekdays, diabetes or blood pressure follow-ups can also be done on a Saturday or Sunday, as late as 9 PM, on Gessner Rd.
features: Glucose, blood pressure and cholesterol control

tiroides.title: Thyroid Testing & Treatment
tiroides.description: Tired, gaining weight or feeling moody? Thyroid tests (TSH, T3, T4) in Houston with hypo- and hyperthyroidism diagnosis and treatment explained in Spanish.
tiroides.longDescription:
When tiredness won't lift, your weight shifts for no clear reason or your hair thins more than usual, your thyroid may be the cause. At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we review your symptoms, measure thyroid function with TSH, T3 and T4, and if you have hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism we start treatment and fine-tune it over time.

## Which symptoms point to the thyroid?

- Exhaustion that doesn't improve even after a full night's sleep
- Gaining or losing weight without changing how you eat
- Hair loss or very dry skin
- Feeling cold when everyone else is comfortable, or overheating and sweating
- Nervousness and a racing heart, or the opposite: low mood and sluggishness

None of these alone proves a thyroid problem, which is why a blood test is the next step.

## What do TSH, T3 and T4 tell you?

**TSH** is the signal your brain sends to tell the thyroid to work, and it is usually the first value checked. **T3** and **T4** are the hormones the gland itself makes. Read together, they let the medical team tell whether your thyroid is running slow (hypothyroidism) or too fast (hyperthyroidism). The sample is drawn at the clinic, and we contact you as soon as the results arrive so we can walk you through them.

## What happens after the diagnosis?

If the results confirm an imbalance, the medical team prescribes a medication and a starting dose based on your levels. The right dose is rarely found on the first try: periodic lab checks help adjust it until both your numbers and your symptoms settle. That is also why you shouldn't stop the pill on your own, even once you feel better.

## I already take thyroid medication. Can you follow me?

Yes, we also monitor patients who were diagnosed elsewhere. Bring your medication box and any earlier lab results; together with a fresh check, that tells us whether your current dose is still right. If you want other values looked at too, you can add [blood work](/en/services/examenes-sangre) during the same visit.

There's no need to book the blood draw ahead: stop by Gessner Rd any day between 9 AM and 9 PM.

alergias.title: Allergy Testing & Treatment
alergias.description: Allergy care in Houston: rhinitis, congestion, skin and respiratory allergies. We look for the triggers and control them, in Spanish, no appointment.
alergias.longDescription:
Sneezing fits, a stuffy nose every morning, watery eyes or itchy welts: Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner treats both respiratory and skin allergies. The medical team listens to when and where your symptoms show up to pin down what sets them off, prescribes treatment and explains how to keep the next flare-up from happening.

## Which allergies do we treat?

- **Allergic rhinitis**: sneezing, a runny nose, an itchy nose and congestion that won't clear
- **Seasonal allergies**, the kind that get worse when the weather turns or pollen counts rise
- **Irritated eyes** that turn red and teary after contact with an allergen
- **Skin reactions**: hives, redness and itching

## How do we find your allergy triggers?

Your own story holds most of the clues. We ask what time of year you feel worse, whether it happens more at home, at work or outdoors, whether there are pets around, whether you switched soap or laundry detergent, and whether symptoms follow a particular food. With those answers and an exam of your nose, throat, eyes and skin, the medical team narrows down the most likely triggers and chooses a treatment.

## What does treatment look like?

It depends on where the allergy shows up and how strong it is. It may include medication to ease congestion, sneezing or itching, plus care for irritated skin. Whatever is prescribed during the visit is handed to you at the [clinic pharmacy](/en/services/farmacia), along with any over-the-counter products you need.

## How can you prevent flare-ups at home?

Much of the control happens outside the clinic. We give you practical advice for your situation: cutting down on dust and pollen indoors, what to do with bedding, when to keep the windows shut, and which cleaning or personal-care products are worth swapping. If a cough or shortness of breath comes along with the allergy, we also check your [respiratory health](/en/services/enfermedades-respiratorias).

If congestion keeps you up at night, the clinic stays open until 9 PM, weekends included.
features: Treatment of respiratory and skin allergies

enfermedades-respiratorias.title: Flu & COVID Testing and Respiratory Illness Care
enfermedades-respiratorias.description: Rapid flu and COVID test in Houston with same-day results and treatment. Flu, cough and bronchitis seen without an appointment, 9 AM to 9 PM, in Spanish.
enfermedades-respiratorias.longDescription:
Fever, cough, body aches and a scratchy throat could mean flu, COVID or another respiratory infection. At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we run rapid influenza and COVID-19 tests with results in minutes, examine your throat and lungs, and treat the flu, lingering coughs, bronchitis and throat infections.

## Which rapid tests do we offer?

- **Influenza (flu)**, using a sample taken from your nose
- **COVID-19**, using a similar swab
- A check of your temperature, breathing, throat and lungs during the same visit

The rapid test result comes back in minutes, while you're still at the clinic, so you leave knowing what you have.

## Why does it matter whether it's flu or COVID?

The symptoms overlap a lot, but the care is not always the same. Knowing the cause lets the medical team choose the right treatment, tell you how many days to rest at home and explain how to protect the people you live with, especially older adults, babies and anyone with diabetes or another chronic illness.

## What else do we treat besides the flu?

A cough that drags on for weeks, thick mucus, wheezing or chest pain when you cough can point to bronchitis. A very sore throat with fever is looked at separately and, when needed, followed up with a [strep test](/en/services/prueba-strep). Either way you leave with clear instructions: which medicines to take, how much fluid to drink, how to bring a fever down and which changes mean you should come back.

## When shouldn't you wait it out?

- Your fever is very high or won't come down with medicine
- Your cough is getting worse instead of better after several days
- You feel short of breath doing simple things

If you have severe trouble breathing, strong chest pain or bluish lips, call 911 or go straight to the emergency room.

When a fever starts on a Sunday afternoon, there's no need to wait for Monday: we run flu and COVID tests until 9 PM, every day of the week.
features: Treatment of flu, cough and bronchitis

examen-fisico-escolar.title: School & Sports Physical Exams
examen-fisico-escolar.description: School and sports physical in Houston, done in one visit with the school forms completed. Walk-ins welcome, open 7 days, in Spanish.
examen-fisico-escolar.longDescription:
Before enrolling in school or joining a sports team, many children and teens are asked for a physical exam. At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner it's done in a single visit: a general checkup, weight, height and blood pressure, vision and hearing screening, and we fill out the form your school or team provided.

## What does the exam check?

- **Weight, height and blood pressure**, to see how growth is going
- **Vision**, by reading a letter chart from a distance
- **Hearing**, to catch trouble hearing in the classroom
- Heart, lungs, abdomen, spine and joints
- Health history, allergies and any medications your child takes

## How is a sports physical different?

For soccer, basketball, track or any other sport, the exam pays closer attention to the heart and the musculoskeletal system. We ask whether your child has ever fainted, felt short of breath or had chest pain during exercise, and whether any relatives had heart problems at a young age. Past injuries to knees, ankles or shoulders are reviewed too, so we know whether it's safe to play.

## What should you bring?

- The form from the school, the district or the sports league, if you got one
- The vaccination card or immunization record
- Glasses or hearing aids, if your child uses them
- The names of any medicines taken regularly

If a vaccine the school requires is missing, we can look into [vaccinations](/en/services/vacunas) during the same visit.

## What if something turns up during the exam?

Most physicals end with a signed form and health tips for the school year. If something needs a closer look, such as a heart murmur, high blood pressure or a vision problem, we explain what it means and what the next step is before clearing your child for sports.

In August, when everyone is rushing to get a last-minute physical, it helps to know we also see patients on Saturday and Sunday until 9 PM, with no booking required.

ginecologia.title: Spanish-Speaking Gynecologist in Houston
ginecologia.description: Gynecology care in Spanish in Houston: Pap smear, vaginal cultures, infection treatment and pregnancy ultrasound. Walk-ins welcome, no insurance needed.
ginecologia.longDescription:
Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner offers gynecology visits in Spanish in Houston, with no appointment and no health insurance required, Monday through Sunday from 9 AM to 9 PM. Visits include Pap smear, vaginal cultures, infection treatment, pregnancy testing and birth control guidance. The clinic is at 1914 Gessner Rd Ste B, in Spring Branch.

## What does the gynecology visit include?

- Pap smear and gynecological checkup
- Vaginal cultures to identify infections
- Treatment of yeast or bacterial infections
- Evaluation of discomfort and abnormal discharge
- Pregnancy test if you need one
- Referral to a specialist when the case requires it

## How does the visit work?

1. Walk in without an appointment or call +1 (346) 226-5820 to reserve a time.
2. The Spanish-speaking medical team reviews your symptoms and history in private.
3. The Pap smear, culture or pelvic ultrasound you need is performed.
4. If there is an infection, we prescribe the treatment and the medicines indicated are handed out at the clinic.
5. We explain the results and next steps in Spanish.

## When should I come in?

Itching, burning, unusual discharge or odor are signs of infection. A culture identifies the cause so the right treatment is chosen. Also come in for your routine Pap smear or if you suspect you are pregnant.

## How much does it cost and how do I pay?

No health insurance is needed. We accept cash, debit and credit cards and mobile payments. Our Promotions page lists packages such as the Complete Women's Checkup for $179 and Women's Intimate Health for $69; prices may change, so confirm by phone.

## Where are you and what are your hours?

1914 Gessner Rd Ste B, Houston, TX 77080, with free parking and wheelchair access. Monday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Phone +1 (346) 226-5820, WhatsApp +1 (832) 831-4016.

## Which areas do you serve?

Houston and the west and northwest side of the city: Spring Branch, Spring Branch West, Hedwig Village, Memorial, Spring Shadows, Long Point, Carverdale and Fairbanks, plus nearby communities.

prueba-embarazo.title: Pregnancy Testing & Confirmation
prueba-embarazo.description: Pregnancy test in Houston with medical confirmation and guidance on next steps, in Spanish and judgment-free. No appointment or insurance needed.
prueba-embarazo.longDescription:
If your period is late or you think you might be pregnant, Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner offers a pregnancy test, urine or blood, and the medical team goes over the result with you in private. The rapid urine test is read in minutes, and then we talk through your next steps, with no judgment.

## Urine test or blood test?

- **Rapid urine test**: picks up the pregnancy hormone and is read in minutes, during the same visit
- **Blood test**: can detect a very early pregnancy; the sample is drawn here and we contact you as soon as the result comes in

The medical team recommends one or the other based on how late your period is and how you feel.

## What happens if the test is positive?

We explain the result calmly and answer your first questions: how to count the weeks of pregnancy, which habits to start right away and which medicines to steer clear of. You also get information about prenatal care and the referrals you need to begin it. If you'd like, follow-up can include an [ultrasound](/en/services/ultrasonido).

## What if it's negative but my period still hasn't come?

A negative result taken very early isn't always the final word. The hormone may still be too low to show, in which case repeating the test a few days later is recommended. If you keep testing negative and your period is still late, we look at other possible causes such as hormonal shifts, stress or thyroid problems.

## Who finds out about my result?

Only you. The visit is private and the result is discussed with you alone; if someone comes with you, you decide whether they join or wait outside. Whatever you choose to do next, we support you with respect. And if you'd like to avoid a pregnancy down the road, we can also talk about [birth control options](/en/services/anticonceptivos).

You don't have to wait until Monday to know for sure: the test is available without an appointment every day, evenings included, until 9 PM.

anticonceptivos.title: Contraceptive Methods
anticonceptivos.description: Birth control in Houston: personalized guidance, pills and the shot, with method start and follow-up. Private consultation in Spanish, no insurance needed.
anticonceptivos.longDescription:
Choosing a birth control method gets easier when someone walks you through the options without rushing. At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner you get a private family-planning visit: we compare methods based on your health and your plans, start the pill or the birth control shot if that's your choice, and follow up to handle side effects or switch methods.

## Which methods can you start here?

- **Birth control pills**, taken once a day
- **The birth control shot**, given at the clinic on a regular schedule
- Guidance on other methods so you understand their pros and cons before deciding

## How do you decide which method fits you?

No single method is right for everyone. The medical team asks about your overall health, your blood pressure, whether you smoke, what medications you take, what your periods are like and whether you want children soon or later on. Your comfort counts too: some women would rather not remember a daily pill, while others would rather skip injections. With all that, you compare the options together and the final call is yours.

## What happens at the first visit?

We review your history and take your vital signs. If there's any chance you're already pregnant, a [pregnancy test](/en/services/prueba-embarazo) rules it out before you start. Then we explain how to use the method you picked, from which day it protects you and what to do if you miss a pill or fall behind on your shot.

## What if the method doesn't agree with you?

Irregular bleeding, headaches or mood changes are common during the first months. Many of these settle down over time, but you don't have to put up with them without checking in: at follow-up we see how you're doing and, if it isn't working, the method is adjusted or changed. If you have an implant you'd like taken out, we also offer [implant removal](/en/services/extraccion-implantes).

If your next shot is due and weekdays don't work, the clinic gives it on Saturdays and Sundays too, between 9 AM and 9 PM.

extraccion-implantes.title: Subdermal Implant Removal
extraccion-implantes.description: Contraceptive implant removal in Houston: outpatient procedure with local anesthesia and aftercare explained in Spanish. No appointment needed.
extraccion-implantes.longDescription:
If the birth control implant in your arm has reached its end date, or you simply want to switch methods, Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner removes it during your visit, no appointment needed. We locate the implant under the skin, numb the area with local anesthetic and take it out through a small incision. You leave with written care instructions.

## What happens during the removal?

- Your arm is examined and the implant is located by touch
- The skin is cleaned and numbed with local anesthetic where the cut will be made
- A cut just a few millimeters long is used to slide the rod out
- The opening is closed with adhesive strips or a stitch and covered with a pressure bandage

The removal itself usually takes only a few minutes and is done by medical staff trained in the procedure.

## Does taking out the implant hurt?

What you notice most is the anesthetic needle, similar to getting a vaccine. After that the area is numb and you only feel pressure or a slight tugging on the skin. Once the numbness wears off you may have some soreness, a small bruise or tenderness for a few days.

## How should I care for my arm at home?

Keep the pressure bandage on for as long as we tell you and keep the wound dry. Avoid lifting heavy things with that arm for the first few days. Watch for spreading redness, pus, warmth or fever; if you notice any of them, come back so we can check the wound.

## What about birth control after removal?

The moment the rod comes out you are no longer protected, and the ability to get pregnant tends to come back fast. If you don't want to get pregnant, decide before the visit which method comes next. During the same visit we can go over [birth control options](/en/services/anticonceptivos) such as the pill or the shot so you're never left unprotected. If you're hoping to conceive instead, we'll guide you on first steps.

Since there's nothing to book, you can come in to have your implant removed any day of the week between 9 AM and 9 PM.

salud-hombre.title: Men's Health Checkup: Prostate (PSA) Exam
salud-hombre.description: Men's checkup in Houston: prostate (PSA) exam, lab tests and results explained in Spanish. Walk-ins welcome, no insurance needed.
salud-hombre.longDescription:
Plenty of men only walk into a clinic once something already hurts. At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner the men's checkup covers PSA, a testosterone level, vital signs and a review of urinary or low-energy symptoms. The medical team explains every result and, if one calls for it, helps you with a specialist referral.

## What does the men's checkup cover?

- **PSA**, short for prostate-specific antigen: a marker measured in your blood that helps monitor prostate health
- **Testosterone**, measured from the same blood draw
- Blood pressure, pulse, weight and other vital signs
- Questions about urination, sleep and how your energy has been

## Which urinary changes are worth getting checked?

Getting up several times a night to use the bathroom, a weak or stop-and-start stream, feeling that your bladder never fully empties, or burning when you pee are problems many men put up with quietly. They can have different causes, from an infection to changes in the prostate, and the only way to know is to look into them. If an infection is suspected, the visit adds a [urinary tract infection](/en/services/infecciones-urinarias) workup.

## Why check hormones if I'm just tired?

Constant fatigue, low mood or a lower sex drive are sometimes linked to low testosterone, but they can also come from other causes such as high blood sugar or a thyroid problem. Measuring it alongside the rest of the checkup lets the medical team confirm or rule out that lead instead of guessing.

## Is there a package for this checkup?

The clinic's flyers list the **Complete Men's Exam** at $89, which bundles a urine test, a prostate test, testosterone and the consultation at no extra charge. Prices can change, so please confirm it by phone at +1 (346) 226-5820 before you come in.

## What happens once the results are in?

We let you know as soon as they're ready and go over them calmly: what each number means and what to do next. If a value is out of range, the plan may be to repeat the test later, start treatment or, when a result calls for it, set you up with a specialist referral.

For men who work Monday through Friday, the checkup can also be done on the weekend: the Gessner Rd clinic is open Saturday and Sunday until 9 PM.

examenes-sangre.title: Blood Tests & Blood Work | Lab
examenes-sangre.description: Blood work in Houston: CBC, chemistry, glucose, cholesterol, thyroid, liver and kidney tests. Walk-in sample collection, results explained in Spanish.
examenes-sangre.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we draw your blood during the visit and send it for analysis to check glucose, cholesterol, triglycerides, blood cells, thyroid, liver and kidneys. It's a good fit if you want a checkup, need to keep a chronic condition under control, or were asked for lab work by an employer or school.

## What can a blood test tell you?

- **Complete blood count (CBC):** counts red cells, white cells and platelets.
- **Blood chemistry:** glucose, cholesterol and triglycerides, the numbers that matter most when watching diabetes or heart health.
- **Thyroid panel:** worth ordering when tiredness, weight shifts or mood changes have no other explanation.
- **Liver and kidney function:** worth checking if you take medication every day, have high blood pressure or live with diabetes.
- **Combined panels:** several tests drawn at once for a general checkup or to see how a treatment is working.

## Do I need to fast before the blood draw?

It depends on what is being measured. Panels that include glucose or triglycerides usually call for fasting, and plain water is fine while you wait. If you're unsure, call +1 (346) 226-5820 before leaving home and we'll tell you how to prepare. Bring a list of your medications too, since some of them can shift certain results.

## How are the tests chosen?

The medical team starts with the reason you came in: a specific symptom, follow-up for [chronic conditions](/en/services/condiciones-cronicas), or a form your employer handed you. That, plus your family history, shapes the order so you don't get extra tubes drawn or miss something that matters. For a routine checkup, ask about the Complete General Checkup promotion, which bundles a general blood panel, A1C and a urinalysis with the consultation included; please confirm it by phone.

## What happens once my results are in?

We let you know as soon as they're ready and walk you through each value in plain Spanish or English. If something is out of range, you leave with a clear plan: repeat the test, change some habits, start or adjust treatment, or get a referral to a specialist when the result calls for one. Keeping your lab work from year to year also makes small changes easier to spot early.

Since the clinic stays open until 9 PM, plenty of patients stop by for their draw after work.

infecciones-urinarias.title: Urinalysis & Urinary Infection Treatment
infecciones-urinarias.description: Urinalysis and UTI treatment in Houston, same day. Burning or urgency when urinating treated without an appointment, in Spanish, no insurance needed.
infecciones-urinarias.longDescription:
Burning when you pee, or rushing to the bathroom every few minutes? Here at Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner, your urine test is done at the clinic, and when it shows an infection you leave with your treatment the same day. Our medical team explains the findings in English or Spanish and how to take the medicine.

## What signs point to a urinary tract infection?

- Burning or stinging every time you urinate
- A sudden, frequent urge to go, even when very little comes out
- Cloudy urine, darker than usual or with a strong smell
- Pressure or aching low in the belly
- In older adults, sometimes only unusual confusion or tiredness

## How is the sample collected, and what happens next?

When you arrive we hand you a sterile cup and show you how to catch a midstream sample after washing your hands and genital area. While the urinalysis is being checked, the medical team asks how long the symptoms have lasted, whether you have had similar infections before and whether you are pregnant or taking other medicines. If the test confirms an infection, you go home with the prescribed treatment, and we hand you the medication at our [pharmacy](/en/services/farmacia), so there is no extra stop at a drugstore.

## When is a urine culture ordered?

If infections keep coming back several times a year, if an earlier treatment did not work, or if the symptoms do not quite fit, the medical team may send a urine culture to identify the bacteria and the antibiotic that works best against it. The culture is a separate study that takes longer than the urine test: we let you know when the result is in and adjust the treatment if needed. If a result calls for it, we guide you through the referral to a specialist.

## Which symptoms suggest the infection may have reached the kidneys?

Fever, chills, pain in the lower back or one side, nausea or vomiting together with painful urination are reasons to come in right away. During pregnancy, any urinary symptom deserves a check, because the infection is treated with medicines chosen to protect the baby as well. Since the clinic sees patients from 9 AM to 9 PM on Saturdays and Sundays too, you do not have to put up with the discomfort until Monday.

examen-heces.title: Stool Tests
examen-heces.description: Stool test in Houston to detect parasites and intestinal infections, with treatment based on the result. Diarrhea and abdominal pain treated in Spanish.
examen-heces.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we analyze a stool sample to look for parasites, intestinal infections and, when needed, hidden blood. It's for children and adults with diarrhea that won't clear up, stomach pain or changes in bowel habits. You get the container and instructions at your visit, collect the sample at home and bring it back.

## Which symptoms call for a stool test?

- Diarrhea that lasts several days or keeps coming back
- Recurring belly pain or cramps
- Unusual gas and bloating
- Changes in the color, texture or frequency of bowel movements
- Weight loss without dieting
- Itching around the anus in kids, which can point to pinworms

## What does the lab look for in the sample?

The general analysis checks how the stool looks, searches for parasite eggs or forms, picks up signs of bacterial infection and spots leftovers that suggest food isn't being digested well. When your history points that way, the medical team adds an occult blood test, which detects bleeding you can't see. Those findings guide whether you need an antiparasitic, a different treatment or further testing.

## How do I collect the sample without contaminating it?

Use the clean container we give you and keep the stool away from toilet water and urine; laying plastic wrap or a disposable tray over the bowl helps. With the scoop built into the lid, take a walnut-sized portion, close the lid tightly and write your name on the label. Drop it off at the clinic as soon as you can, and if there's a delay, keep it in the fridge, never the freezer.

## What happens after I drop off the container?

We let you know when the result is ready and explain in Spanish or English what was found. If a parasite or infection shows up, you leave with the prescribed treatment plus tips to keep it from spreading at home, like careful handwashing and rinsing fruit. If symptoms persist or the result calls for it, we help you with a referral to a specialist. When cramps come with burning on urination, checking for a [urinary tract infection](/en/services/infecciones-urinarias) may also make sense.

The front desk is open 9 AM to 9 PM all seven days, so you can drop off the container whenever it suits you.

prueba-strep.title: Strep Test
prueba-strep.description: Rapid strep test in Houston with results in minutes and treatment if positive. Sore throat seen without an appointment, in Spanish, 7 days a week.
prueba-strep.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we run the rapid strep test with a throat swab, and you get the result in minutes during the same visit. It tells you whether a bad sore throat is strep throat, which needs specific treatment, or a virus that clears up on its own. We test both children and adults.

## Which signs point to strep throat?

- Severe throat pain that came on suddenly
- Fever and pain when swallowing, even saliva
- Red, swollen tonsils, sometimes with white spots or patches
- Tender, swollen glands in the neck
- In kids, headache, stomachache or vomiting along with the sore throat

Coughing, a runny nose and hoarseness, on the other hand, tend to come with viruses. That's why the test helps: the symptoms overlap, and only the swab settles the cause.

## How is the swab taken?

You open wide and stick out your tongue while our medical staff rubs a long swab across the back of the throat and the tonsils. The swipe is over quickly, and while some people gag a bit, it isn't painful. For young children, sitting on a parent's lap makes it easier. The sample is then processed right there while you wait.

## What if the test is positive?

The medical team prescribes the right antibiotic and explains why you need to finish every dose even if you feel better after a couple of days, since stopping early raises the risk of complications. We also tell you when your child can go back to school and how to keep the rest of the household from catching it, such as not sharing cups or utensils and replacing the toothbrush.

## And if it comes back negative?

A virus is the most likely cause, and antibiotics won't help with that. We give you ways to ease the pain and bring the fever down, and we explain which warning signs should bring you back, like trouble breathing or opening your mouth. If a cough or congestion is also hanging on, we look into other [respiratory illnesses](/en/services/enfermedades-respiratorias).

When a sore throat starts late on a Saturday, the clinic is still open until 9 PM and sees patients on Sunday too.

prueba-tuberculosis.title: Tuberculosis (TB) Test
prueba-tuberculosis.description: TB test (PPD skin test) in Houston for work, school or immigration, with result reading included. No appointment or insurance needed, in Spanish.
prueba-tuberculosis.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we place the tuberculosis skin test (PPD) and read it when you come back 2 or 3 days later. It's the test commonly required by healthcare jobs, schools, daycares and volunteer programs. You leave with a documented result for your paperwork and a clear explanation of what it means.

## How is the PPD test placed?

A very fine needle puts a small amount of fluid just under the skin of your forearm. A little bump forms and fades on its own within a short while. There's no fasting or preparation, and placing it takes only a few minutes of your visit. Beforehand, our medical staff asks whether you've ever had a positive PPD or received the BCG vaccine as a child, since either one affects how the result is read.

## Why is a second visit needed to read the PPD?

The skin reaction takes time to develop, so a PPD is read 48 to 72 hours after placement; that's why you return 2 or 3 days later. At the reading, the firm, raised area on your arm is measured with a ruler, not just the redness. If you miss that window, the test can't be read and has to be repeated.

## How should I care for my arm until then?

- Don't scratch the spot or cover it with a bandage.
- Shower as usual and pat the area dry.
- Skip lotions or creams on the site.
- If the skin turns very red or blisters, let us know before the reading.

## What if the test comes back positive?

A positive result doesn't mean you're sick or contagious: it often reflects a dormant infection or an earlier BCG vaccine. The usual next step is a chest X-ray and a check for symptoms such as a lingering cough, fever or night sweats. We guide you through those steps and, if your case calls for it, a referral to a specialist, so you can still meet your employer's or school's requirement.

## What paperwork do I take with me?

After the reading you get a record showing the placement date, the reading date, the measurement in millimeters and the interpretation. Check ahead of time which format your job or school wants, and bring their form if they have one. If your school also asks for shots, you can look at our [vaccines](/en/services/vacunas) service during the same trip.

Because we're open on weekends, you can get the test placed on a Friday or Saturday and come back for the reading without missing work.

enfermedades-transmision-sexual.title: Sexually Transmitted Disease (STD) Testing
enfermedades-transmision-sexual.description: Confidential, judgment-free STD testing in Houston with treatment if the result is positive. No appointment or insurance needed, care in Spanish.
enfermedades-transmision-sexual.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner STD testing is confidential: the medical team reviews your symptoms and the kind of exposure you had, collects the samples you need and, if anything comes back positive, gives you treatment. It's for men and women, whether you have symptoms or simply want peace of mind.

## When does it make sense to get tested?

- After sex without a condom, or if a condom broke
- When a partner tells you they have an infection
- If you notice burning when you pee, discharge, sores, warts or itching in the genital area
- Before starting a new relationship or stopping condoms with your partner
- As part of your regular checkup if you have more than one partner

Many of these infections cause no discomfort for months, so having no symptoms doesn't rule anything out.

## Which tests can be done?

Depending on what you share during the visit, we collect a urine sample, a blood sample or a swab from the affected area. Those samples screen for the most common infections. Some blood tests pick up an infection more reliably once a few weeks have passed since the exposure, and we'll tell you if a repeat test later is a good idea.

## How is the privacy of my results protected?

The visit is private, your chart is kept confidential, and your results are discussed with you alone. We let you know when your results are in and go over them calmly, without judgment, in English or Spanish, whichever you prefer.

## What if a test is positive?

Most of these infections are treatable, and several are fully cured with medication. You leave with clear instructions: how to take it, how long to avoid sex, and why your partner needs to be checked too so you don't get reinfected. If the result calls for it, we help you with a referral to a specialist. For women, our [gynecology](/en/services/ginecologia) service can round out the exam.

If you'd rather not come in during office hours, the clinic sees patients until 9 PM, when it's usually quieter.

examen-alcohol-drogas.title: Alcohol & Drug Testing
examen-alcohol-drogas.description: Drug and alcohol testing in Houston for employment and paperwork, with a fast process and documented results. No appointment needed, service in Spanish.
examen-alcohol-drogas.longDescription:
When a new job, your current employer or a personal matter calls for an alcohol and drug test, Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner handles it quickly and discreetly. We collect the sample for drug screening, run the alcohol test and hand you documentation of the result to submit to your employer or to whichever office requested it.

## When might you be asked for this test?

- **Before starting a job**, as part of the hiring process
- **While employed**, for checks your company requires
- **Personal matters** that ask you to show there's no substance use
- Requirements from staffing agencies or contractors

## How is the sample collected?

When you arrive, we ask for a photo ID and, if you have one, the order or form from your employer. For the drug screen you provide a urine sample, and the alcohol test is done separately. The medical staff tells you what comes next at each step, in Spanish or English, so nothing is unclear.

## Who gets the result?

The result is confidential. Only you, plus anyone you give permission to, such as the employer who ordered the screen, get a copy of the documented result. If your company uses its own form or procedure, bring it and we'll review it before collecting the sample.

## What should you mention before the test?

If you take prescription medication, especially for pain, anxiety, sleep or attention, say so before giving the sample and bring the bottle or prescription. Some drugs can show up on a screen, and having them on record helps the result be read correctly. If you need a medical exam to drive commercial vehicles, see the [DOT physical](/en/services/examen-dot).

If your new job starts on Monday, it helps to know the test is also available on weekends, until 9 PM.

electrocardiograma.title: Electrocardiogram (EKG)
electrocardiograma.description: Electrocardiogram (EKG) in Houston, quick and painless, for checkups and medical exams. No appointment or insurance needed, result explained in Spanish.
electrocardiograma.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner the electrocardiogram (EKG) is done during your visit: electrodes placed on your chest, arms and legs record your heart's electrical activity in a few minutes, painlessly. We order it for palpitations or high blood pressure, during checkups, and when a job, a sport or a surgery requires a heart screening.

## What can an EKG show?

- Whether your heart beats in a regular rhythm or has an arrhythmia
- Whether the rate is too fast or too slow
- Signs that the heart muscle is under strain, common after years of high blood pressure
- Changes that suggest the heart isn't getting enough oxygen
- A baseline to compare against at future checkups

## How should I prepare?

No fasting is needed. A two-piece outfit helps, since your chest has to be uncovered, and skipping lotions or oils on your skin that day keeps the electrodes from slipping. If you take medication for blood pressure, your heart or your thyroid, bring the names written down.

## What happens during the test?

You lie on your back on the exam table while our medical staff attaches the adhesive electrodes. During the recording you just stay still and breathe normally; talking or moving can blur the tracing. The machine sends no electricity into your body, it only reads what your heart produces. Then the electrodes come off and you can go on with your day.

## Who reviews the tracing, and what comes next?

The medical team interprets the tracing and explains what it shows in plain language, alongside your blood pressure and symptoms. If it's normal, it works for your paperwork or as a reference. If something needs a closer look, we lay out the next steps, which may include [blood tests](/en/services/examenes-sangre) and, when the result calls for it, a referral to a specialist.

Important: if you have severe chest pain spreading to your arm or jaw, shortness of breath or a cold sweat, call 911 instead of coming to the clinic.

A routine EKG fits into an evening stop on the way home, since we see patients until 9 PM, weekends included.

examen-dot.title: DOT Physical Exam - CDL License
examen-dot.description: DOT physical in Houston for your CDL license with a same-day certificate. Vision, hearing and blood pressure check, in Spanish, no appointment needed.
examen-dot.longDescription:
If you drive a commercial vehicle and need to get or renew your CDL, Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner performs the DOT physical. We review your medical history, check your vision, hearing and blood pressure, complete the physical exam the DOT requires and, if you meet the standards, you leave with your medical certificate the same day.

## What does the DOT physical check?

- **Medical history**: conditions, surgeries and medications you take
- **Vision**, each eye, with the glasses or contacts you drive with
- **Hearing**, to confirm you can hear a spoken voice from a distance
- **Blood pressure and pulse**
- A urinalysis and a general physical: heart, lungs, abdomen, spine, reflexes and mobility

## How can you prepare so nothing holds you up?

Fill out the driver's section of the form ahead of time; you can download it from the [FMCSA](https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/medical/driver-medical-requirements/medical-examination-report-form-commercial-driver-medical-certification) website or complete it here. Bring your driver's license, the glasses or hearing aids you use, and a list of your medications with their doses. If you take blood pressure pills, don't skip them that day.

## What if you have diabetes, high blood pressure or another condition?

Having a chronic illness doesn't mean you can't drive, but it does mean you should come prepared. If you use insulin, have sleep apnea or a heart condition, bring recent reports or test results from your follow-up care. With that information the medical team decides how long the certificate will be valid; when a condition needs closer monitoring, it may be issued for less than the maximum period. If your blood pressure or blood sugar isn't well controlled, we can also help through our [chronic condition care](/en/services/condiciones-cronicas).

## How long is the medical certificate valid?

According to the [FMCSA](https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/medical/driver-medical-requirements/dot-medical-exam-and-commercial-motor-vehicle-certification), the certificate can be valid for up to 24 months when the driver meets every standard. Write down the expiration date and come back before it arrives so you're never stuck unable to work.

For drivers who spend the week on the road, the DOT physical is available without an appointment on Saturdays and Sundays too, between 9 AM and 9 PM.

examenes-inmigracion.title: Immigration Medical Exam I-693

sueros-vitaminados.description: Vitamin IV drips and IV hydration in Houston. Energy, recovery and immune support administered by medical staff in Spanish. Walk-ins welcome.

2. Medical staff review your symptoms and confirm the drip is right for you.
3. The IV line is placed and the drip is administered while you sit under observation.
4. When it is done we give you instructions and, if useful, a follow-up plan.

## Does it replace a medical visit?

No. A drip does not replace a diagnosis: if fatigue persists, we offer blood work to look for the cause, such as vitamin B12 deficiency or thyroid problems.

## How much does it cost and how do I pay?

The price depends on the type of drip and the vitamins added. No health insurance is needed; we accept cash, debit and credit cards and mobile payments. Our Promotions page lists offers such as the blood panel plus vitamin B12 injection package for $99; confirm the price by phone.

suturas-heridas.title: Wound Suturing
suturas-heridas.description: Stitches for cuts and wounds in Houston, no appointment: cleaning, closure and aftercare instructions in Spanish. Open 9 AM to 9 PM, no insurance.
suturas-heridas.longDescription:
When a cut is deep or its edges gape open, Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner cleans it and closes it with stitches during the same visit, no appointment needed. Our medical team numbs the area with local anesthesia when appropriate, checks that nothing is left inside the wound and explains home care in English or Spanish.

## Does every cut need stitches, or only some?

- It keeps bleeding even after pressing on it with a clean cloth for a good while
- The edges pull apart and will not stay together on their own
- It is deep enough to show the yellow layer of fat under the skin
- It sits on the face, the fingers or over a joint that bends a lot
- It was caused by something dirty, rusty or by broken glass

## What happens while the wound is stitched?

First we rinse the wound thoroughly and remove any visible dirt or splinters. Once the local anesthetic has taken effect, the medical staff brings the edges together with stitches sized to the length and depth of the cut, then covers it with a clean dressing. During the procedure you feel pressure or tugging rather than the needle itself. If the cut came from something dirty and you cannot remember your last tetanus booster, we check whether you are due for the [vaccine](/en/services/vacunas) and can give it during that same visit.

## How should you look after the stitches at home?

Keep the dressing on and dry for as long as we tell you, wash your hands before touching the area, and avoid rubbing, scratching or soaking it in a bathtub or pool. Once we say you can wash it, use water and mild soap and pat it dry. Come back sooner than planned if redness spreads, pus appears, the area feels hot or you develop a fever.

## Who removes the stitches, and when?

We take the stitches out right here. Timing depends on where the wound is: stitches on the face usually come out sooner than those on a knee, the back or the sole of the foot. When we finish closing the cut we tell you when to return, and because we stay open until 9 PM every day, you can drop by after work. If a wound keeps bleeding despite firm pressure or is very large, call 911.

curacion-heridas.title: Wound Care
curacion-heridas.description: Wound care in Houston: cleaning, disinfection, dressing changes and follow-up until healed. Care in Spanish, no appointment or insurance needed.
curacion-heridas.longDescription:
Wound care at Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner means cleaning, disinfecting and re-dressing a wound you already have, and checking its progress at every visit until it closes. It is meant for surgical wounds, minor burns, ulcers and scrapes that are slow to heal, and our medical staff handles it on a walk-in basis.

## Which wounds can be treated here?

- Surgical incisions that need their dressings changed
- Minor burns, such as from an iron or hot cooking oil
- Ulcers and sores that will not finish closing
- Scrapes or cuts that got dirty or started to ooze
- Stitched wounds that need checking before removal

## What happens at each wound care visit?

We gently take off the old dressing, wash the wound and disinfect it. The medical team then looks at the color of the edges, how much fluid there is, any odor and the size, comparing it with the last visit to see whether it is improving. Finally we apply a fresh dressing chosen for a dry or a draining wound. If there are signs of infection, treatment is prescribed and you can pick up the prescribed medication at our [pharmacy](/en/services/farmacia) before you leave.

## How often should you come in?

There is no fixed rule: it depends on the type of wound, how much it drains and how it responds. Each visit ends with the date of your next dressing change. With hours from 9 AM to 9 PM seven days a week, fitting a dressing change in before work, after your shift or on a weekend is easy.

## Which signs mean you should come in sooner?

Come before your scheduled visit if redness grows, pus or a bad smell appears, pain increases instead of easing, or you run a fever. If you live with diabetes or poor circulation, wounds, especially on the feet, heal more slowly and run into trouble more easily, so frequent checks matter; if you need help keeping your blood sugar in range, we cover that under [chronic conditions](/en/services/condiciones-cronicas).

## What can you do at home between visits?

- Keep the dressing clean and dry, and change it if it gets wet
- Wash your hands before and after touching the area
- Skip home remedies, toothpaste or ointments unless we approve them
- Keep clothing and shoes from rubbing against the wound

cirugias-menores.title: Minor Surgery
cirugias-menores.description: Minor surgery in Houston to remove moles, cysts and lipomas under local anesthesia, in a single visit. Outpatient procedure explained in Spanish.
cirugias-menores.longDescription:
At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we perform minor outpatient surgery, such as removing moles, cysts and lipomas, during the same visit and without an appointment. The medical team first evaluates the growth, uses local anesthesia when appropriate and explains each step in English or Spanish, so you head home with the area covered.

## What can be removed with minor surgery?

- Moles that catch on clothing, get nicked when shaving or bother you cosmetically
- Cysts that form under the skin and sometimes flare up
- Lipomas, the soft fatty lumps that slide when you press them
- Other small skin and soft-tissue growths the medical team considers suitable
- Ingrown toenails, which have their own [treatment page](/en/services/unas-encarnadas)

## How does the procedure go?

Before starting we ask whether you take blood thinners or aspirin, whether you are allergic to any anesthetic and whether you have diabetes or another condition. Then we clean the skin, mark the area and apply local anesthesia; from that point you feel no pain, just some pressure while the growth is removed. If the incision needs it, a few stitches close it and a dressing goes on top. Everything happens in the exam room, with no hospital stay and no need to be put to sleep.

## What aftercare follows?

When we finish, we explain how long to keep the dressing on, when the area can get wet and which activities to avoid depending on the location. Mild soreness once the anesthetic wears off is normal. Come back before your scheduled visit if you notice spreading redness, pus or a fever. If you received stitches, we also remove them at the clinic when the time comes.

## What if the growth looks like it needs a closer look?

Not every growth should be removed in the office. If the medical team sees a mole that has changed shape or color, or a lesion that calls for a different kind of study, they tell you plainly and we guide you through the referral to a specialist. That way the decision is made with information, not in a rush.

Because we are open from 9 AM to 9 PM on Sundays too, you can pick a day when you will not have to go straight back to work with a freshly treated hand or leg.

drenaje-abscesos.title: Abscess Drainage
drenaje-abscesos.description: Abscess drainage in Houston under local anesthesia to relieve pain and stop the infection. Same-day care, no appointment needed, in Spanish.
drenaje-abscesos.longDescription:
When pus collects under the skin and gets trapped, it forms a painful, warm, swollen lump known as an abscess. At Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner we drain it during the same visit, no appointment needed: the medical team numbs the area with local anesthesia, opens and empties the abscess, cleans it and decides if the infection needs treatment too.

## How is an abscess different from an ordinary pimple?

- The lump is red, warm and more painful each day
- It feels soft to the touch, as if there were fluid inside
- Sometimes a white or yellow head shows in the center
- It can come with fever, chills or a general sick feeling
- It tends to show up in the armpits, groin, buttocks or wherever hair and friction meet

## Why shouldn't you squeeze it at home?

Pressing an abscess with your fingers or poking it with a household needle rarely empties it fully and can push the infection into the surrounding skin. It also hurts far more without anesthesia. At the clinic it is opened with clean instruments after the area is numbed, and all the pus comes out at once; that is what relieves the pressure and the pain.

## What happens after the drainage?

The wound is covered with gauze and, depending on its size, left open so fluid can keep draining for a few days. We show you how to change the gauze and tell you when to come back for a check; if needed, we continue with [wound care](/en/services/curacion-heridas) at the clinic. When the medical team prescribes an antibiotic or other medicine, we hand it to you at the clinic pharmacy before you go.

## When should you come in without waiting?

Get seen promptly if the lump grows fast, a red streak spreads from it, you have a fever, the abscess is on your face or near the eye, or you live with diabetes or a weakened immune system. If abscesses keep coming back, it is worth checking your glucose with a [blood test](/en/services/examenes-sangre). The clinic is open from 9 AM to 9 PM on weekends as well, so an abscess that gets worse on a Saturday does not have to wait until Monday.

unas-encarnadas.title: Ingrown Toenail Removal in Houston
unas-encarnadas.description: Ingrown toenail removal in Houston, TX. Procedure with local anesthesia in Spanish, with affordable pricing.
unas-encarnadas.longDescription:
Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner treats ingrown toenails in Houston with a simple procedure under local anesthesia, done during the same visit. Care is in Spanish, with no appointment and no health insurance required, Monday through Sunday from 9 AM to 9 PM, at 1914 Gessner Rd Ste B, Spring Branch.

## What does the treatment include?

- Evaluation of the nail and toe
- Local anesthesia so the procedure does not hurt
- Removal of the ingrown portion of the nail
- Treatment of the infection if present
- Care instructions to prevent recurrence

## How is the procedure done?

1. Walk in without an appointment or call +1 (346) 226-5820 to reserve a time.
2. The medical team examines the toe and checks for infection.
3. Local anesthesia is applied to the toe.
4. The ingrown portion of the nail is removed and the area is cleaned.
5. You leave the same day with a dressing and aftercare instructions in Spanish.

## When should I come in?

Pain, redness, swelling or pus around the nail, especially on the big toe. Treating it early keeps the infection from spreading. If you have diabetes, come in as soon as you notice discomfort.

## How much does it cost and how do I pay?

We charge a fixed price for the procedure, no health insurance needed; it covers the consultation, local anesthesia, removal and aftercare instructions. We accept cash, debit and credit cards and mobile payments. Call us and we will confirm the exact price before your visit.

farmacia.title: Pharmacy
farmacia.description: Medicines prescribed during your visit, handed out at the same Houston clinic, plus over-the-counter products. We explain how to take them, in Spanish.
farmacia.longDescription:
The pharmacy at Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner has one clear job: handing you the medications prescribed during your visit before you leave, and offering over-the-counter products. That way, after seeing our medical team, you start treatment without another stop, and we explain how to take each medicine in English or Spanish.

## What does the clinic pharmacy carry?

- The medications prescribed at your visit here, brand-name or generic
- Over-the-counter (OTC) products for colds, pain, fever and allergies

## How does pickup work once your visit ends?

When the medical team finishes your evaluation and settles on a treatment, the staff prepares the prescribed medications and hands them to you at the counter before you go. We tell you the cost before you pay and mention a generic option when one exists. You can pay with cash, a debit or credit card, or your phone.

## What do we explain when we hand you the medicine?

- Your dose, and how to space it through the day
- Whether a meal should come before or alongside it
- How many days to keep going even once you feel better
- How to get back on track if a dose slips your mind
- Which side effects are expected and which deserve a call

## Which visits make it most useful?

It helps most when feeling sick will not wait. If you are diagnosed with a [urinary tract infection](/en/services/infecciones-urinarias), you walk out with the treatment in hand; the same goes after an abscess drainage, a throat infection or an allergy flare. For older adults, or anyone who comes in with sick kids, skipping the line at another store makes a real difference.

## Can you stop by just for an over-the-counter product?

Yes. OTC pain relievers, cold medicines and antihistamines can be bought without a visit, and the staff can point you to the one that fits what you need. Because the clinic stays open until 9 PM every day, it also works when you need something for a fever late in the evening. Medications that need a prescription are handed out only after an evaluation by the medical team.

privacy.title: HIPAA Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document provides a formal summary of the manner in which Clínica Hispana Nueva Salud Gessner complies with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) as it relates to information collected, transmitted, or stored through its official website. The Clinic is committed to maintaining the privacy, confidentiality, and security of Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with federal regulations and applicable state laws.
privacy.collectionText: The website may collect personal and identifying information voluntarily submitted by users, including but not limited to name, email address, telephone number, appointment requests, and limited health-related information provided through secure electronic forms.
privacy.protectionText: Any Protected Health Information submitted electronically is protected through appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards, including Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption, restricted system access, and secure data storage protocols.
privacy.useText: Information obtained through the website is used exclusively for legitimate healthcare operations, including scheduling appointments, responding to inquiries, facilitating billing processes, and coordinating patient care. Under no circumstances is Protected Health Information sold, leased, or disclosed for unauthorized marketing purposes.
privacy.thirdPartyText: When third-party service providers are engaged in functions that involve access to PHI, the Clinic ensures that a valid Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is executed in compliance with HIPAA requirements.
privacy.rightsText: Patients retain all rights afforded under HIPAA, including the right to access their health records, request amendments to inaccurate information, request restrictions on certain disclosures, and receive an accounting of disclosures when applicable.
privacy.complaintsText: Individuals may file privacy-related complaints without fear of retaliation by contacting the Clinic's designated Privacy Officer or the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.
privacy.disclaimerText: The information presented on the Clinic's website is intended for general informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Users are encouraged to consult directly with a qualified healthcare provider regarding any medical concerns. In the event of a medical emergency, individuals should immediately call 911 or seek appropriate emergency medical services.
